summary: OBJECT at 2 MUST-FIX and 2 SHOULD-FIX. The frozen subject, repository pins, eight citing-file hashes, eleven predecessor/successor movement rows, ten citation rows, all 27 citation sites, first quoted sites, recording headings, ordered leftoverDesign partitions, and every named projection field reproduce. D-000 authority also holds under clauses 1 through 3 together with D-293's express A4 authorization. The draft cannot be adopted unchanged because Decision clause 2 gives contradictory outcomes for a same-partition change in another projected field; Decision clause 3 treats the inclusive D-261-through-D-287 range as recorded precedent even though D-272 is CONTESTED and records no successor; the rationale misclassifies mixed-trigger D-286 as merely refreshing its cross-citation in passing; and the live-remasurement paragraph says every leftover-join named in tables is current even though those tables deliberately name superseded versions.

mustFix.title: The expanded projection has contradictory trigger and no-op rules
mustFix.finding: Clause 2(b) first says a sibling successor requires a new citer when it changes the leftoverDesign partition. Its mechanical test then projects registerRow, file08StatusToken, liveGateOwners, and four obligation fields and says any projected-value change requires a successor. The closing sentence again says a version-number hunt with equal partitions flags nothing. A successor that preserves the partition but changes an owner, status token, routing field, or ride standing therefore both requires and does not require a citer successor under the same operative clause.

evidence.narrowTrigger: a sibling successor changes the leftoverDesign partition the citing join relies on
evidence.broadRule: A successor is required whenever any of those projected values changes.
evidence.narrowNoOp: A hunt that flags a join on version number alone, with the partitions equal, flags nothing.
evidence.d293AdoptedStandard: A change in any relied-on cross-lineage fact requires a successor; the post-round note names the exact projected fields.

mustFix.requiredRepair: Make clause 2(b)'s trigger a change in any projected value, and make the no-op sentence require equality of every projected value, not merely equality of leftoverDesign partitions. Preserve the exact projection fields and the ten measured PASS results.
mustFix.whyMustFix: This is the operative reading rule. As written it gives opposite outcomes for the field changes the D-293-authorized amendment was specifically added to govern.

mustFix.title: The blanket refresh precedent includes CONTESTED D-272
mustFix.finding: The clause says D-261 through D-287 refreshed cross-lineage citations. That inclusive range contains D-272, whose COORD status is CONTESTED, whose Decision is 'None,' and whose text says language-quality leftover-join.v5 is not recorded as current. D-273 records v5 in a later new cycle. The top branch recital correctly excludes D-272, but the operative refresh clause does not.

evidence.recordingEntry: D-273 — new cycle after CONTESTED D-272, not a fourth turn

mustFix.requiredRepair: Qualify the precedent as the adopted successors in that interval and explicitly exclude D-272, or use the already-recorded split D-261 through D-271 and D-273 through D-287. Apply the same qualification to clause 2(a) if its D-261-through-D-287 phrase is intended as an exhaustive decision range.
mustFix.whyMustFix: An operative COORD rule cannot treat a parked CONTESTED decision with no recording act as adopted precedent.

shouldFix.title: D-286 is a mixed-trigger successor, not an in-passing citation refresh
shouldFix.finding: The rationale places D-286 only in the occupancy-remasurement list and says its cross-citation was refreshed in passing. The exact-bytes v7 predecessor role expressly identifies two stale inputs that v7 remasures: occupancy v3 after occupancy v4 (D-210), and component-manifest leftover-join.v4 after component-manifest leftover-join.v9 (D-282). D-286 is therefore both occupancy-driven and citation-driven.

evidence.citationTrigger: component-manifest leftover-join.v4 stale after component-manifest leftover-join.v9 (D-282)

shouldFix.requiredRepair: Describe D-286 as a mixed occupancy-and-citation successor. It may remain in the occupancy list, but remove 'in passing' for D-286 and include it among citation-driven GATE examples or state the overlap expressly.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: The ten current projection comparisons and the convention's central conclusion remain supported; this defect misstates one precedent's trigger classification.

shouldFix.title: The blanket currentness sentence includes versions the tables identify as superseded
shouldFix.finding: The paragraph says every leftover-join named in the tables is the current recorded join of its lineage, then says every superseded version named is not current. The first movement table names eleven superseded versions, and the citation table names ten superseded cited versions. The two halves cannot both be true as written.
